note: Parameters of the internal readiness model (services/readiness.py). Nothing here is an official exam fact except where a source is named. Entries marked assumption are modelling choices, written down so they can be checked and changed; changing one changes every estimate. The model is calibrated against real practice tests as soon as Zee enters them (see calibration in docs/v2/metrics.md).

prior.note: Uniform Beta(1,1): no prior belief. With no evidence the range is the whole scale.

half_life_note: assumption: skills fade, older evidence counts less
target_from: pass_points / module_max_points of the chosen Goethe exam (data/official/goethe_b1.json), the share of points that passes

vocab.census: Share of the Goethe B1 word list that is mature in your cards (stability 21 days or more) or known from placement. Used when the word list file exists; otherwise the placement vocabulary items at B1 level.
vocab.measure: Take the placement test, or add the Goethe B1 word list (data/private) for a count over your cards.

reading.measure: Answer the questions after a text in Lesen.

listening.proxy: Diktat measures spelling from audio, not comprehension, so each answer counts half. A listening comprehension task is not in the app yet.
listening.measure: Do the five Diktat sentences in Hören.

writing.proxy: Counts correct uses and errors the grader finds in your own sentences. Exam raters also mark task fulfilment and coherence; that needs the essay task (a later phase).
writing.measure: Write the daily task in Schreiben.

speaking.proxy: Counts correct uses and errors in spoken sessions; shadowing counts 0.3 because it measures recognition, not speaking. Pronunciation is not measured.
speaking.measure: Finish a voice session and read its review in Sprechen.
